lines.en: label day283:
scene nodokafirstclass1
Today is the day that Nodoka transfers into the class, but I’m assuming you could have figured that out based on how she is standing right in front of everyone right now.
lines.zh: 今天是 Nodoka 转进这个班的日子，不过我猜你看她现在就站在所有人面前，应该已经猜到了。

lines.en: I’m sure it will be a relatively normal introduction given that she’s proven to be a relatively normal girl thus far.
lines.zh: 鉴于她到目前为止表现出的都是一个相对正常的女孩，我敢肯定这次自我介绍也会相对正常。

lines.en: Well, when she’s not talking about her [incest] fetish.
lines.zh: 嗯，只要她不谈她那个[incest]癖好。

lines.en: But, now that I think about it, I guess every single introduction we’ve had in this class has been slightly out of the ordinary.
lines.zh: 不过现在想想，我们这个班的每一次自我介绍好像都有点不太寻常。

lines.en: I think the current record holder would actually be Uta, who flavor beamed Makoto and proceeded to arm wrestle Yumi.
lines.zh: 我觉得目前的纪录保持者其实应该是 Uta——她对着 Makoto 放了美味光波，然后还跟 Yumi 掰了手腕。

lines.en: So yeah, it would be pretty hard to have a bad introduction by comparison.
lines.zh: 所以是啊，相比之下，想要有个糟糕的自我介绍还挺难的。

lines.en: : Good evening, everyone.
lines.zh: : 大家晚上好。

lines.en: : My name is Nodoka Nagasawa and I will be transferring into this class starting today.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Nodoka Nagasawa，从今天起转入这个班。

lines.en: : Which one of you is Yumi?
lines.zh: : 你们哪位是 Yumi？

lines.en: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: 哦豁。

lines.en: : Nodoka!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！

lines.en: : Yumi’s not here today! Did you want me to text her something?
lines.zh: : Yumi 今天不在！要我给她发点什么消息吗？

lines.en: : What a shame. I was looking forward to meeting her.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我还挺期待见她的。

lines.en: : Really? Then what can I-
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那我能不能——

lines.en: : Leaving a message won’t be necessary. I’ll just proceed with the rest of my introduction and meet her some other time.
lines.zh: : 留言就不必了。我继续把自我介绍做完，改天再找她吧。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass2
: Natsume Soseki once said, “Like the first whiff of burning incense, or like the taste of one's first cup of saké, there is in love that moment when all its power is felt.”
lines.zh: : 夏目漱石曾经说过：「正如焚烧香料的第一缕气息，或初尝第一杯清酒的滋味，爱情中也有那样一个瞬间，能让人感受到它的全部力量。」

lines.en: : Now, I don't know much about love. But I can tell each and every one of you that this, too, is a moment of great power.
lines.zh: : 现在，我对爱情所知不多。但我可以告诉你们每一个人，此刻同样是一个充满力量的瞬间。

lines.en: : For I see it as the first step toward the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 因为我将它视为通往此后永恒的第一步。

lines.en: : I’m sure there are plenty memories to be made here...plenty of fun experiences for all of us to have together.
lines.zh: : 我确信这里会留下许多回忆……还有许多我们可以共同拥有的有趣经历。

lines.en: : Living through all of that with you is why I exist now.
lines.zh: : 能和你们一起经历这一切，正是我此刻存在于此的意义。

lines.en: : And while I may not feel the specific power Soseki mentioned in this very moment, I’m sure that I will look back on it only to be swallowed whole.
lines.zh: : 虽然此刻我或许感受不到漱石所说的那种具体的力量，但我确信当我回首时，会被它整个吞没。

lines.en: : Swallowed by the nostalgic waves of[school] life as if it were every first sip of sake in the entire world, formed into a single tidal wave approaching our bodies quicker than we’re approaching graduation.
lines.zh: : 被[school]生活的怀旧浪潮吞没，那浪潮仿佛是全世界每一口初尝的清酒汇聚成的一道巨浪，扑向我们身体的速度，比我们走向毕业的速度更快。

lines.en: : As if it were a cloud of incense smoke laced with the same scents that bring us comfort when we lay our heads to our pillows at night.
lines.zh: : 又像是一团香火的烟雾，掺着我们夜晚把头枕上枕头时那些令我们安心的气息。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass3
: I do not expect to change your lives, nor do I expect you to change mine.
lines.zh: : 我不指望改变你们的人生，也不指望你们改变我的。

lines.en: : But what I {i}do{/i} expect is to enjoy the time we all have together, for it will be gone long before that smoke dissipates.
lines.zh: : 但我{i}确实{/i}期待的，是享受我们共度的时光，因为它会在那缕烟散尽之前就早已消逝。

lines.en: : Did we...
lines.zh: : 我们是不是……

lines.en: : Did we get a normal girl?
lines.zh: : 我们是不是来了个正常的女孩？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass4
: Hey, isn’t that the super smart girl from our old[school]?
lines.zh: : 嘿，那不是我们以前那所[school]里超级聪明的女生吗？

lines.en: : The one who kinda just sat in the library all day and never went to any classes or anything?
lines.zh: : 就是那个整天窝在图书馆里，从不来上课也不干别的的那个？

lines.en: : I never went to the library at our old[school], so I wouldn’t know.
lines.zh: : 我以前那所[school]的图书馆我从来没去过，所以我不知道。

lines.en: : That’s gotta be her. But why would she be in a class like this?
lines.zh: : 肯定就是她。可她为什么会在这种班里？

lines.en: : I never would’ve wound up in the same room as her if we were going by the old[school]’s rules. I’m like a gajillion levels below her.
lines.zh: : 要是按以前那所[school]的规矩，我根本不可能和她待在同一个教室里。我比她低了好几亿个等级。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass5
: You’re a gajillion levels below everybody, Uta. But that’s okay. We all still love you anyway.
lines.zh: : 你比所有人都低好几亿个等级，Uta。不过没关系。我们大家还是照样爱你。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass6
: Can I leave now? I have a class to teach.
lines.zh: : 我现在能走了吗？我还有课要上。

lines.en: I walk over to Wakana in the middle of Nodoka’s speech to see if she needs a hug or something.
lines.zh: Nodoka 讲到一半的时候，我走到 Wakana 身边，看看她是不是需要个拥抱什么的。

lines.en: : Sorry, but Nodoka was insistent on you watching her introduction.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过 Nodoka 坚持要你看完她的自我介绍。

lines.en: : I don’t understand why. She’s supposed to be your problem now.
lines.zh: : 我不明白为什么。她现在该是你的问题了。

lines.en: : If I knew I’d be spending even {i}more{/i} time in this room, I would have just continued to deal with her on my own.
lines.zh: : 如果我知道我还得在这间屋子里待{i}更{/i}久，我宁可继续自己一个人对付她。

lines.en: : But the last introduction you were here for was so memorable.
lines.zh: : 可你上次旁听的那个自我介绍多令人难忘啊。

lines.en: : Yes. It was simply delightful watching a girl with brightly colored hair talk about falling in love with you before she was even able to walk.
lines.zh: : 是啊。看着一个头发颜色鲜艳的女孩讲她还没学会走路就爱上了你，那可真是愉快极了。

lines.en: : People learn how to walk before they’re six years old, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 人六岁之前就学会走路了，Wakana。

lines.en: : Why? Do they not realize how exhausting walking is?
lines.zh: : 为什么？他们难道不知道走路有多累吗？

lines.en: : They should spend every waking moment simply sitting around until people start asking them for things.
lines.zh: : 他们应该把醒着的每一刻都用来坐着不动，直到别人开始来求他们办事。

lines.en: : ...Okay, Wakana. You can leave now.
lines.zh: : ……好吧，Wakana。你现在可以走了。

lines.en: : Thank you. And it’s {i}Miss Watabe{/i}, you spineless prick.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。还有，是 {i}Watabe 老师{/i}，你这个没骨头的混蛋。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。再见。

lines.en: scene black
Wakana exits the classroom and I make my way back over to the podium, hoping that Nodoka hasn’t noticed.
lines.zh: Wakana 走出教室，我回到讲台边，希望 Nodoka 没有注意到。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass7
: Alas, my dearest Miss Watabe. Now truly is the winter of our discontent.
lines.zh: : 唉，我最亲爱的 Watabe 老师。现在真的是我们不满的冬天了。

lines.en: : She’ll be back. I wouldn’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 她会回来的。我倒不会担心。

lines.en: : I miss her already.
lines.zh: : 我已经开始想她了。

lines.en: : Cool. Is your speech over yet?
lines.zh: : 好。你的演讲结束了吗？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass8
: Not quite. There is one thing I still have to do. And I apologize in advance for any commotion it may cause.
lines.zh: : 还没。我还有一件事要做。我提前为它可能引起的骚动道歉。

lines.en: : What are you going to do, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你要做什么？

lines.en: : Something a friend of mine has assured me can not possibly go wrong.
lines.zh: : 一个朋友向我保证，这件事绝对不可能出错。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass9
: I learned recently that the best way to make a good impression in this class is by proclaiming your love in front of everyone.
lines.zh: : 我最近了解到，在这个班里给人留下好印象的最好办法，就是当着所有人的面宣告你的爱。

lines.en: : Oh no.
lines.zh: : 哦不。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass10
: Hey! She got that idea from me!
lines.zh: : 嘿！那主意是她从我这儿学去的！

lines.en: : You don’t...actually think your introduction worked out in your favor, right?
lines.zh: : 你不会……真觉得你那次自我介绍对你有利吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. But I wasn’t going to just stand there and let the man of my dreams think I’m just some normal girl.
lines.zh: : 当然不。不过我也不会就这么站着，让我梦中的男人以为我只是个普通的女孩。

lines.en: : I say good on Nodoka for following her heart.
lines.zh: : 我说 Nodoka 追随自己的心，做得好。

lines.en: : Uh-huh.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : But didn’t she go home with Sensei yesterday? What if her heart belongs to the same guy yours does?
lines.zh: : 可她昨天不是和 Sensei 一起回的家吗？万一她的心和你的一样，都属于同一个男人呢？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass11
: They did not “go home” together. They went on a mission to my old stomping grounds that I couldn’t be there for since I had work.
lines.zh: : 他们才没有「一起回家」。他们是去我以前常混的地方执行任务了，我因为要上班没能去成。

lines.en: : And if they fell in love during that mission?
lines.zh: : 那要是他们在任务途中相爱了呢？

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : Sensei is mine and no one else is allowed to fall in love with him.
lines.zh: : Sensei 是我的，其他任何人都不许爱上他。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass12
scene nodokafirstclass13
: Hi!
: I like your hair.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你的头发。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : I like yours too.
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢你的。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass14
: Even though I may be as fresh in your minds as the morning dew...I, too, have a heart.
lines.zh: : 虽然我在你们记忆中或许还像晨露一样新鲜……但我也有一颗心。

lines.en: : And that heart has been beating nonstop since I laid my eyes on someone in this very classroom.
lines.zh: : 而自从我的目光落在这间教室里的某个人身上，那颗心就一直跳个不停。

lines.en: : If one more girl lays her stupid eyes on Sensei I’m blowing the[school] up.
lines.zh: : 要是再有一个女生把她那该死的眼睛瞄上 Sensei，我就把这所[school]炸了。

lines.en: : Oh god! What if it’s me?! Makoto! Are girls even allowed to date girls here?!
lines.zh: : 哦天啊！万一是我怎么办？！Makoto！这里女生跟女生谈恋爱是允许的吗？！

lines.en: : As long as there are no public displays of affection, of course. The same goes for heterosexual couples.
lines.zh: : 只要不在公共场合秀恩爱，当然允许。异性恋情侣也是一样的规定。

lines.en: : Also, stop interrupting her introduction! This is the closest we’ve had to a normal student since the[school] year started and I will not let you ruin it!
lines.zh: : 还有，别再打断她的自我介绍了！这可是开学以来我们最接近正常学生的一次，我不会让你们毁了它！

lines.en: : Since the dawn of time, the core fundamental of all living things has been the same...To {i}survive.{/i}
lines.zh: : 自时间之初，一切生命最根本的内核都是一样的……那就是{i}生存{/i}。

lines.en: : To survive, you must not only defend yourself, but mate. Reproduce.
lines.zh: : 要生存，你不仅要保护自己，还要交配。繁衍。

lines.en: : To carry on and strengthen the lineage. To grow, like trees.
lines.zh: : 去延续并强化血脉。像树一样生长。

lines.en: : And for that reason, I have selected who I will be spending the rest of my life with.
lines.zh: : 正因如此，我已经选好了要与之共度余生的人。

lines.en: : And that person is...
lines.zh: : 那个人就是……

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass15
: Futaba Fukuyama!
lines.zh: : Futaba Fukuyama！

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass16
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : Ami! This is great news!
lines.zh: : Ami！这是个好消息啊！

lines.en: : This means our chances of ending up with Sensei stay exactly the same instead of getting worse again!
lines.zh: : 这意味着我们和 Sensei 在一起的概率保持不变，而不是又变差了！

lines.en: : Yeah! This is the best news I’ve heard all-
lines.zh: : 对啊！这是我今天听到的最好的消——

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass17
: Wait! Stop hitting on my [uncle]!
lines.zh: : 等等！别再勾引我的[uncle]了！

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass18
: It’s not biologically possible for us to reproduce, Nodoka!
lines.zh: : 我们在生理上根本不可能繁衍后代，Nodoka！

lines.en: : {size=-10}Futaba has a girlfriend before me. Futaba has a girlfriend before me.  Futaba has a girlfriend before me.  Futaba has a girlfriend before me.  Futaba has a girlfriend before me.  Futaba has a girlfriend before me.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}Futaba 比我先有女朋友。Futaba 比我先有女朋友。Futaba 比我先有女朋友。Futaba 比我先有女朋友。Futaba 比我先有女朋友。Futaba 比我先有女朋友。{/size}

lines.en: : Don’t worry, life-partner! I’m already in the process of researching how it would be possible for us to naturally conceive!
lines.zh: : 别担心，人生伴侣！我已经在研究我们怎么才能自然受孕了！

lines.en: : It's not looking good so far, but how do you feel about starting on supplements just in case?
lines.zh: : 目前看来不太乐观，不过你觉得要不要先吃点补剂以防万一？

lines.en: : Bad!
lines.zh: : 不好！

lines.en: : What kind of supplements are you even thinking of?!
lines.zh: : 你到底在想什么补剂啊？！

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass19
: {i}Two mothers. How beautiful.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}两位母亲。何其美好。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I wonder how many fathers would be required.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我很好奇这需要多少位父亲。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I will have to ask the Emerald Guardian to teach me about reproduction soon.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我得尽快请翡翠守护者教教我关于繁殖的事。{/i}

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass20
: My dearest Futaba, are you rejecting me? After all of these years? After all of the laughs we have shared? The breasts we have compared?!
lines.zh: : 我最亲爱的 Futaba，你是在拒绝我吗？在这么多年之后？在我们分享过的所有欢笑之后？在我们比较过的胸部之后？！

lines.en: : Yes! Stop giving people the wrong idea!
lines.zh: : 是的！别再让别人误会了！

lines.en: : I don’t believe you!
lines.zh: : 我不信！

lines.en: : Come! Let us consummate our future together on Miss Watabe’s desk!
lines.zh: : 来吧！让我们在 Watabe 老师的桌子上圆房，成就我们的未来！

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass21
: Two girls...in a relationship together...
lines.zh: : 两个女孩……在一起交往……

lines.en: : Is that sort of thing...common?...
lines.zh: : 这种事……常见吗？……

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Do you not, like...know about bisexuals and lesbians and stuff, Sana?
lines.zh: : 你难道……不知道双性恋和女同性恋什么的吗，Sana？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass22
: O-Of course I know about them! I’ve just never talked to any...so...it’s a little confusing to me.
lines.zh: : 我……我当然知道啊！我只是从来没和她们说过话……所以……我有点搞不明白。

lines.en: : Well...is there anything in particular you’re confused about?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你具体是哪方面搞不明白？……

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass23
: I don't know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : Can you...maybe just...teach me everything that {i}you{/i} know?...
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}能不能……就……把你知道的都教给我？……

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass24
: Ah! Rin! Your nose!
lines.zh: : 啊！Rin！你的鼻子！

lines.en: : Wha-
: How on earth could something like this happen?!
lines.zh: : 这种事到底是怎么发生的？！

lines.en: : What a strange turn of events that I don’t understand in any way at all!
lines.zh: : 这真是一个我完全无法理解的离奇转折！

lines.en: : Is there anything I can do to...make you feel better?...
lines.zh: : 有什么我能做的……能让你好受一点吗？……

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass25
: NOPE! TOTALLY GOOD! THANKS, SANA!
lines.zh: : 没有！完全没事！谢了，SANA！

lines.en: : Oh...okay...
: Well...tell me if you change your mind...
lines.zh: : 那……你要是改主意了告诉我……

lines.en: : Yup! Mind is totally under control! Definitely nothing weird going on in there! Hahahahah!
lines.zh: : 嗯！脑子完全在掌控之中！里面绝对没有发生任何奇怪的事！哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Haha...hah...
scene nodokafirstclass26
: Okay, I think that’s a long enough introduction.
lines.zh: : 好了，我觉得这自我介绍够长了。

lines.en: : You’ve already caused several of the girls to start spiraling into chaos, so I think it’s safe to say you’ve done your job now.
lines.zh: : 你已经让好几个女生开始陷入混乱了，所以我想可以放心地说，你的任务完成了。

lines.en: : Sensei, need I remind you that all I’m doing is creating memories?
lines.zh: : Sensei，需要我提醒你吗，我所做的一切都只是在创造回忆？

lines.en: : I get that. But it's starting to get loud in here.
lines.zh: : 我懂。不过这里开始有点吵了。

lines.en: : But Futaba and I were {i}this{/i} close to finally hooking up.
lines.zh: : 可 Futaba 和我离终于搞在一起就差{i}这么{/i}一点了。

lines.en: : We were not, Nodoka!
lines.zh: : 我们才没有，Nodoka！

lines.en: : See? She’s all about it.
lines.zh: : 看吧？她可愿意了。

lines.en: : Sensei, if the introduction is over, do you think I could have a minute of your time?
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果自我介绍结束了，能占用你一点时间吗？

lines.en: : Go ahead, Sensei. I’ll maintain order in the classroom.
lines.zh: : 去吧，Sensei。我会维持教室秩序的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will...
lines.zh: : 我确信你会的……

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass27
: What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I just wanted to bring something I heard from the principal to your attention.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你注意一件我从校长那儿听到的事。

lines.en: : Do you know anyone by the name of Otoha Okakura?
lines.zh: : 你认识叫 Otoha Okakura 的人吗？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. She’s a friend of several of the girls here.
lines.zh: : 哦，认识。她是这里好几个女生的朋友。

lines.en: : Is she transferring in already?
lines.zh: : 她已经要转进来了吗？

lines.en: : Well, you have to sign off on the form still, but yes. She’s been approved.
lines.zh: : 嗯，表格还得你签字，不过是的。她已经被批准了。

lines.en: : Great. Is that the end of our meeting then?
lines.zh: : 太好了。那我们的会就开到这儿？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass28
: Well, not exactly.
lines.zh: : 嗯，还不太算。

lines.en: : It’s true that the matter with Otoha was the most urgent, but there is something else that is concerning to me as well.
lines.zh: : Otoha 那件事确实最紧急，不过还有一件让我担心的事。

lines.en: : You? Concerned? That doesn’t sound good to me.
lines.zh: : 你？担心？听起来可不妙啊。

lines.en: But hey, as long as it doesn’t lead to her freaking out and deliriously offering a dual blowjob with her best friend again, I’m sure it will be fine.
lines.zh: 不过嘛，只要别又演变成她精神崩溃、神志不清地拉上她最好的朋友一起提出要双人吹箫，我敢肯定就没什么问题。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass29
: The thing is, we were supposed to be getting cut off from new students at sixteen since that’s all the[school] thinks you’re able to handle.
lines.zh: : 问题是，我们本来应该在十六人之后就不再接收新学生了，因为[school]认为你只能应付这么多。

lines.en: : That’s actually rather generous of them given how I’ve been lately.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我最近的表现，他们其实已经相当宽容了。

lines.en: : It really is, but that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: : 确实如此，不过这不是重点。

lines.en: : Because I found out today that two {i}more{/i} girls after this Otoha character will be transferring in. And each of them requires special care.
lines.zh: : 因为我今天发现，在这个 Otoha 之后{i}还{/i}会有两个女生转进来。而她们每一个都需要特殊照顾。

lines.en: : Oh, I can handle “special care.”
lines.zh: : 哦，「特殊照顾」我可是很在行的。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass30
: Oh, I am well aware of how you are with “special care.” But that’s not what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 哦，我非常清楚你对「特殊照顾」是个什么态度。不过我说的不是这个。

lines.en: : Well then what do they need exactly?
lines.zh: : 那她们到底需要什么？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass31
: One of them appears to be the daughter of an extremely wealthy family- even moreso than Ayane's.
lines.zh: : 其中一个似乎来自一个极其富有的家庭——甚至比 Ayane 家还有钱。

lines.en: : So we've been urged to essentially just...give her anything she wants whenever she wants.
lines.zh: : 所以我们被要求基本上就是……她想要什么就给她什么，什么时候要就什么时候给。

lines.en: : And I have no idea {i}why{/i}, but it seems that you were personally requested to be her teacher.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道{i}为什么{/i}，不过似乎有人指名要你当她的老师。

lines.en: Personally? And someone even more wealthy than Ayane?
lines.zh: 指名要我？而且比 Ayane 家还有钱？

lines.en: The Dojo girl?
lines.zh: 是那个道场女孩？

lines.en: : That’s strange. I don’t really understand why she would-
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。我不太明白她为什么会——

lines.en: Wait a second.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: Didn't that rich woman at the onsen mention having another daughter?
lines.zh: 温泉里那个有钱女人不是提过她还有个女儿吗？

lines.en: : Chika, do you remember Tsubasa’s last name?
lines.zh: : Chika，你还记得 Tsubasa 姓什么吗？

lines.en: : Hm? It was Tsukioka. Why? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？是 Tsukioka。怎么了？出什么事了？

lines.en: : Tsubasa?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa？

lines.en: : Where were you with Chika that you wound up running into the apparent mother of the richest family in Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你和 Chika 到底去了什么地方，居然会碰上 Kumon-mi 最有钱那家人的母亲？

lines.en: : A petting zoo. It was completely wholesome.
lines.zh: : 一个宠物动物园。完全是健康纯洁的场合。

lines.en: : Anyway, who is the second girl?
lines.zh: : 总之，第二个女孩是谁？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass32
: See, this is the part that really confuses me.
lines.zh: : 你看，这才是真正让我困惑的地方。

lines.en: : She doesn’t have any parental or guardian signatures on any of her paperwork, which isn’t a problem on its own since there are several girls in[school] in similar conditions-
lines.zh: : 她的所有文件上都没有父母或监护人的签名，这本身倒不是问题，因为[school]里有好几个女生情况类似——

lines.en: : But I think there was an issue with Kumon-mi Academy’s data backup server as her entire student file is a mix between blank pages and redacted statements.
lines.zh: : 不过我怀疑 Kumon-mi 学园的数据备份服务器出了点问题，因为她的整份学生档案全是空白页和被涂黑的语句混在一起。

lines.en: : The only note I could find just mentioned “special care.”
lines.zh: : 我唯一能找到的备注只提到了「特殊照顾」。

lines.en: : I’ve never seen anything like it before.
lines.zh: : 我从来没见过这种事。

lines.en: : I do have her name, but...that doesn't really help us at all.
lines.zh: : 我确实有她的名字，不过……那对我们一点帮助都没有。

lines.en: : Well, at least tell me that.
lines.zh: : 那至少告诉我吧。

lines.en: : It’s Yasu Yasui.
lines.zh: : 叫 Yasu Yasui。

lines.en: : I wasn’t even able to speak with any of her teachers since every single one of them hung up on me as soon as I asked about her.
lines.zh: : 我连她任何一个老师都没能说上话，因为我一问起她，他们就全都挂了电话。

lines.en: : Well...I guess there’s really no way of telling what she’ll be like until we meet her then, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想在见到她之前，确实没办法知道她是什么样的人，对吧？

lines.en: : Right...but it’s still strange. So I just wanted to do my part in letting you know.
lines.zh: : 是啊……不过这还是很奇怪。所以我只想尽我的一份力，把这事告诉你。

lines.en: : Well thanks. I appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢了。我很感激。

lines.en: : Meeting adjourned? I want to take a nap.
lines.zh: : 散会了？我想睡个午觉。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass33
: Um...no. There was one more thing. But I guess it’s not really that important.
lines.zh: : 呃……没。还有一件事。不过我想也不算太重要。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. What is it?
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。是什么？

lines.en: : I was just wondering...and it’s okay if you say no-
lines.zh: : 我只是想问……你拒绝也没关系——

lines.en: : But I was wondering if maybe you’d like to...accompany me somewhere soon.
lines.zh: : 不过我在想，你愿不愿意……近期陪我去个地方。

lines.en: : That depends, I guess. Where did you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 那得看情况吧。你想的是哪儿？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass34
: Well...our next beach trip is coming up in a month or two, and I wanted to make sure the facilities were still...up to par.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们下一次海滩之行再过一两个月就到了，我想确认一下那边的设施还……合不合格。

lines.en: : And it’s not like the two of us got to spend much time together there last time, so...
lines.zh: : 而且上次我们俩在那儿也没能待上多少时间，所以……

lines.en: : The beach trip is coming up?
lines.zh: : 海滩之行要到了？

lines.en: : Isn’t it the middle of winter?
lines.zh: : 现在不是大冬天的吗？

lines.en: : They’re open all year. The season won’t change anything.
lines.zh: : 那里全年开放。季节不会改变什么。

lines.en: : I’m sure it won’t be as fun as it was in the summer, but-
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定不会像夏天那次那么好玩，不过——

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass35
: Wait...but how would we have gone with you in the summer when the[school] year didn’t start until...
lines.zh: : 等等……可[school]年不是到……才开始吗，我们夏天怎么可能和你一起去过……

lines.en: scene happy4
scene nodokafirstclass35
: Sure, yeah. I’ll go.
lines.zh: : 当然，行。我去。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass36
: You will?!
lines.zh: : 你愿意？！

lines.en: : Sure. I think it sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 当然。我觉得听起来挺好玩的。

lines.en: : Perfect! Just let me know whenever you're ready and I’ll make the arrangements!
lines.zh: : 太好了！你什么时候准备好就告诉我，我来安排！

lines.en: : You’re going to have to pay, though.
lines.zh: : 不过得你付钱。

lines.en: : I’d ask my mom, but I don’t think she’d be keen on the idea of the two of us going on a mini vacation together.
lines.zh: : 我本来想问我妈要的，不过我觉得她不会太赞成我们俩一起去度个小假。

lines.en: : Inviting me on a trip and making me pay? Classic Makoto.
lines.zh: : 邀我出去玩还要我付钱？不愧是 Makoto。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstclass37
: How is this classic Makoto? I have never done anything like this before.
lines.zh: : 怎么就不愧是 Makoto 了？我以前从来没做过这种事。

lines.en: : You haven’t. But it {i}feels{/i} like you have.
lines.zh: : 你是没有。不过{i}感觉{/i}上你做过。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Nothing. I’m going to take a nap now.
lines.zh: : 没什么。我要去睡午觉了。

lines.en: : I’ll call you when I’m ready to go, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我准备好出发的时候会给你打电话。

lines.en: scene black
$ makotobeachinvite = True
$ makotobeachticket = True
{i}Congratulations! You have unlocked a special trip with Makoto!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你解锁了和 Makoto 的特别之旅！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Try calling her on a Saturday afternoon after you've tied up any loose ends with her best friend.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}试着在周六下午给她打电话吧——在她和她最好的朋友之间的未了之事都了结之后。{/i}

lines.en: The rest of the day goes by normally, with things not settling down until it’s nearly time to leave.
lines.zh: 这一天剩下的时间正常地过去了，直到快放学时一切才安定下来。

lines.en: It sounds like Otoha will be transferring in soon-
lines.zh: 听起来 Otoha 很快就要转进来了——

lines.en: Which means I should probably start scotchguarding all of the corners and desks so Rin won’t crack her skull open when she inevitably faints from excitement.
lines.zh: 这意味着我大概该开始给所有的墙角和课桌喷上防污保护剂，免得 Rin 到时候激动得晕过去，把脑袋磕裂。

lines.en: The classroom really is getting livelier by the day...
lines.zh: 这个教室真的是一天比一天热闹了……

lines.en: $ nodoka_love += 1
$ day283 = True
{i}Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]！{/i}
